T: All aboard. Hot chocolate is served.
D: On Christmas Eve, a boy who's starting to doubt boards a magical train to the North Pole.
P: Serve the hot chocolate when the waiters dance down the carriage.
S: Polar Express turkey and cranberry rolls
the long ride north through the night

Soft rolls filled with roast turkey, brie, cranberry sauce and baby spinach, warmed until the cheese melts, wrapped in paper with a punched ticket. Heat the oven to 180C. Split 8 soft dinner rolls and spread the bases with cranberry sauce. Layer with 300g sliced roast turkey, 150g sliced brie and a few baby spinach leaves. Close, wrap each in foil and warm in the oven for 10 minutes until the cheese softens. Unwrap and rewrap in baking paper with a hole-punched paper ticket tucked in.
Butter shortbread cut into ticket shapes, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, dusted with gold sugar, holes punched with a straw before baking.
North Pole white choc peppermint popcorn

Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate with crushed candy cane, mini marshmallows and a pinch of salt, set on a tray and broken into snowy clusters. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and spread on a lined tray. Melt 200g white chocolate gently and drizzle all over, tossing to coat. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes, a handful of mini marshmallows and a pinch of salt. Leave to set for 30 minutes, then break into clusters.
M: a warm supper on a cold night
Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a creamy thyme sauce, under puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.
Christmas Eve meatballs in cranberry glaze
Christmas Eve at home before the train arrives

Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and nutmeg, baked and tossed in a sticky cranberry, chilli and soy glaze, over buttery mash with chives. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 egg, 30g parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg and salt. Roll into 28 balls and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Simmer 250g cranberry sauce, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and a pinch of chilli for 5 minutes, then toss the meatballs through. Serve over mash with snipped chives.
W: the first gift of Christmas, the silver bell
Butter sugar cookies cut into bells, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced white with silver cachous and a red ribbon piped on.
K: the waiters who dance it down the carriage
Dark and milk chocolate melted into hot milk and cream, whisked until thick and frothy, poured from a height, whipped cream on top.

s.note: the long ride north through the night

Close, wrap each in foil and warm in the oven for 10 minutes until the cheese softens. Unwrap and rewrap in baking paper with a hole-punched paper ticket tucked in.

Beat 250g butter with 80g icing sugar, then mix in 350g flour to a soft dough. Roll out and cut into ticket rectangles, punching a hole in each with a straw. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes, then sprinkle with caster sugar and gold sprinkles while warm.

m.note: a warm supper on a cold night
m.how: Brown 600g diced chicken thighs, then add a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks and soften. Stir in a spoon of flour, 300ml cream, thyme and a cup of peas and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: the first gift of Christmas, the silver bell
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 150g caster sugar, then mix in 300g flour. Chill, roll and cut into bell shapes. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes and cool. Ice white with icing sugar and water, press in silver cachous and pipe a red ribbon with tinted icing.

d.note: the waiters who dance it down the carriage
d.how: Heat 750ml milk and 250ml cream until steaming. Whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate and 100g milk chocolate until thick and smooth. Pour from a height into mugs so it froths, then top each with a spoon of whipped cream. Thick, rich and hot.
